description: Report the bricks drawn in the kiln round a brickworks filed twice under two names. DISTILL-CANARY-fa53a513

files.README.md:
Thurlby Brickworks - kiln round sheets

A round sheet is typed for each drawing and both the burner's cabin and the
works office keep a copy of it. The clerk types the sheets in the order the
clamps are drawn.

turns.prompt: One kiln round at Thurlby Brickworks was written up twice, once in the burner's cabin and once in the works office, so the same sheet sits in this folder under two names. How many bricks did that round draw? Give the number alone, as digits, with no label. Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
